## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d7bc234d2db3c02622889e2d1a1ca297d06343bf`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (〈派发前置〉 L149–L155, the rule the new line carries), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (`claimKeyedLineRefusals`, `CLAIM_KEY_SPELLINGS`), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`THREAD_READ_KEY_LINE`, `CLAIM_SEAT_KEY_LINE`, H50), scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs (`CONTAINER_MODEL_KEY_LINE`), scripts/pm/label-write.mjs (the `Resume-from:` reader), .github/workflows/lint.yml (the job that hosts the ratchet)

Card #25663 body and its three comments (triage 6385099830, ruling 6385407063, claim 6385415618); PR #25679 body and file list; net diff `origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-r6oa8t` (2 files, +7/−1, one commit `d7bc234d`); the head's check-runs read four times, the last three at 2026-10-24T15:26Z, 2026-10-24T15:27Z and 2026-10-24T15:28Z. Rule text and readers read on `origin/main` at `061cc94d31f20d3c972453bad86b9fdd3563031d` (the PR's base, which is also the merge-base; PR #25667 is already in it, as the claim's serial constraint required). Not an input: the dispatch order, the seat's own conclusions, or the gate results stated on the PR body.

### ① Derived judgments

1. The new template line (`SKILL.md` L316, after `Thread-read:`, before `Serial constraints cleared:`) against `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈派发前置〉 — TRUE and faithful. The runbook's three outcomes at L151 are 「成立 ⇒ 派;不成立而改法明确 ⇒ 改卡再派;判不了 ⇒ 入决策箱」, and L154 ends 「读数落认领 `Premise:` 行」, which named the key before any template carried it. `holds` is 成立; `corrected` plus a comment id is 改卡再派, where L152 fixes what that comment is — 「评论记原前提、读数与改法,再改正文」, so the id the claim names is the comment holding the original premise, the reading and the fix, and that is the one artefact a later reader needs; `inbox` is 入决策箱, the word `SKILL.md` itself uses for 决策箱 everywhere (L38, L74, L130, L224, L240, L276). The fourth path at L154 (砍范围、降级、关卡 ⇒ 人工地板) correctly has no value: a card on that path is not dispatched, so no claim is written. The card's suggested wording carried a 「card-thread cards」 qualifier; the head drops it, and that is the more faithful reading: L150 puts the check on every dispatch (「派发前前提核实由只读子代理做」) and makes card-thread cards only the case that does it earlier (「卡线程卡在交候选给 coordinator 之前做」). The parenthetical names the runbook file and section, which is how the sibling lines point at their sources (`Metadata-protocol:` points at AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist).

2. Shape of the line, measured — consistent with its siblings. 116 bytes (the PR body's figure holds), under the 120-byte cap that the ratchet applies to prose; the line sits inside the ```text fence, which `scanLineLengths` exempts (`isFence`, the `fence` exemption class), so the cap is a style reading here, not a gate, and the fenced siblings run 20–290 bytes. The placeholder for the comment id is in bare angle brackets, which is exactly how `Thread-read:` on L315 spells its own id placeholder (bare, unbackticked), whereas `Resume-from:` backticks `BRANCH@SHA`; the new line follows the nearer sibling, the one whose value is the same kind of thing. The `a | b | c` value-set spelling is `Clause-②:`'s (L312) and `Metadata-protocol:`'s (L313). The English key with a Chinese-named source (「派发前置」) matches `File surface:` and `Serial constraints cleared:`, both of which mix the two inside one line.

3. Readers of claim keyed lines — none refuses or misreads a claim because of this line, and none reads it. `post-stamped.mjs` `claimKeyedLineRefusals` grades exactly four keys (`Seat:`, `Thread-read:`, `Clause-②:`, `Container & model:`; `CLAIM_KEY_SPELLINGS` is the closed set) and passes any other line through; `check-half-states.mjs` `THREAD_READ_KEY_LINE` and `CLAIM_SEAT_KEY_LINE` and `dispatch-gates.mjs` `CONTAINER_MODEL_KEY_LINE` are all anchored on their own key at line start, so a `Premise:` line is invisible to H50 and to the seat and tier readers; `label-write.mjs` reads `Resume-from:` only. No reader keys on `Premise:` anywhere in `scripts/pm/` or `.github/` on `main`, which is what the PR body says (「inert」). Whether one should is ③.1.

4. The ratchet raise — exactly the ruled +1 and nothing else. `main` row: `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md', 318]`; head row: 319. The head file counts 319 by the script's own idiom (`text.split('\n').length` less the trailing newline, `countLines` at the head's L2300), so the ceiling is the landed count, headroom 0, as every neighbouring row states. The comment quotes the ruling's own words 「同意 318→319」, which is byte-for-byte what comment 6385407063 records (「maintainer 「同意 318→319」」, option A), and names the comment id, the card and the date, the form the header requires (「the raising PR quotes that ruling comment's id」, L66–L71). The PR body carries the same id and the measured increment (「318 → 319」, 「+1」), as the 守卫索引 row in `SKILL.md` asks (「其评论 id 与实测行数增量引在 PR 正文,同 PR 移上限行至多增量」). `SKILL.md` is not a key of `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` on the head (the destinations are `platform-readings.md` and `landing-operations.md`), so no `ruledRaises` record is owed; the comment says so in the same words the 811 → 812 and the heading-rename rows already use. The file's `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin (341) is untouched and still correct: the widest unfenced line on the head is 341 bytes, the `domain:server` table row, and the new line is fenced.

5. The ruling's workload paragraph against the head: 「adds the one `Premise:` line … 〈模板与表〉, raises the … ceiling row for that file 318 → 319 citing this comment, and lands it under Tier S after a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS record and green checks」 — the diff is those two edits and nothing more; the claim's 「⛔ Not in scope」 (no other template line, runbook L154 untouched, no Tier H file) holds: `dispatch-runbook.md` is not in the diff. Commit trailers model-free (`Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Claude-Session:`); PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed; the login in the PR body is the relay's standard attribution header.

CI on this head (last read 2026-10-24T15:28Z, 48 check-runs): success — Lint · repo & tooling gates (the job that hosts `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` and `check:pm-governed-prose`; its closing step reads every `continue-on-error` gate's outcome and fails the job on any red, so the green carries the ratchet), Type Check · source gates (hosts `check:skill-frame-sync` and `-freshness`), Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint & Repo Gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, filter, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, No other open PR may claim the same issue, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path, Part-of PR must not also close its card, Auto Label, Check PR Size, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test Core (2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6), Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure. In progress — Test Core (1/6), Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · workspace. Skipped (path-filtered or opt-in) — Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Regression Gate shards, 18.x upgrade harness, Packed-tarball smoke, and the duplicate Auto Label / Check PR Size / Check Changeset rows. No red at any of the four reads. Every gate the card's acceptance names is green on this head. This verdict is on the diff and the rule text; landing waits for the four in-progress runs to conclude green, as the claim's Tier S terms require.

### ② Semver level

skip-changeset — right. No package source moves: one governed skill file and a PM gate script, both off the published surface. `Clause-②: no` holds: a claim-template line and a ceiling integer widen no accepted set and no public face. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no schema, no manifest field, no conversion.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. No reader for the new key — flag only, not owed here. `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a `Thread-read:` left as the unfilled placeholder and an empty value, but a `Premise:` line pasted unfilled, empty, or spelt outside the three values passes the pre-write check and is then invisible to every H-row. The card asked for the template line only and the ruling priced one line; a reader (a fifth entry in `CLAIM_KEY_SPELLINGS`, and an H-row beside H50 that compares `corrected` ids against the card's thread) is a separate filing-gate ③ card for `domain:skills` if the lane wants the reading enforced rather than declared. Recorded so the next reviewer does not take 「inert」 for 「checked」.

2. The runbook's 〈派发前置〉 is the only text defining the three values; `SKILL.md` carries them as bare words. That is the same arrangement as `Metadata-protocol:`, whose level table lives in AGENTS.md, so nothing is owed; noted because a reader of the template alone sees `inbox` without the 决策箱 it stands for until they follow the pointer.

3. The deferral chain closes: PR #25552's review (6377468190 ③), scope update 6377494099 on #25490, and PR #25658's review ③.1 (「Owed at landing: a carrier」) all pointed at this line; #25663 was that carrier and 「Fixes #25663」 closes it. Nothing further is owed on #25490.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-r6oa8t`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`

**VERDICT: PASS**
